current_system_limitations: Anti-Gravity CLI does not expose an open HTTP port directly; requires bridge adapter or web API proxy.
Python is not currently bound in system PATH (Node.js 24 is the primary active script runner).

security_warnings: Never expose raw 'agy --dangerously-skip-permissions' to unauthenticated public web traffic without strict input validation.

Preserve LF line endings for all scripts deployed to production Ubuntu 24.04.
